data.description:
# Plan-review Pass-2 `prerequisite_verify` fails on Bedrock "Grammar compilation timed out", forcing INDETERMINATE

Reproduced **twice, deterministically**, on two different revisions of the same ticket
([rebar:c827-2a23-cd00-473e]). Both runs failed at the SAME step with the SAME provider error:

    step 'review@then/prerequisite_verify' failed: the LLM provider call failed:
    status_code: 400, model_name: us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6,
    body: {'Error': {'Message': 'The model returned the following errors:
           Grammar compilation timed out.', 'Code': 'ValidationException'}}

Run 1: 7 findings, all `reason: "no-verification"` -> INDETERMINATE, unsigned.
Run 2 (after remediation; description substantially rewritten, so a different payload):
6 findings, all `reason: "no-verification"` -> INDETERMINATE, unsigned.

## Why this is a gate defect, not just a flaky call

* **0 blocking findings in both runs.** Every deterministic gate passed except the advisory
  `P6 ac-quality`. The plan was never rejected on merit — it could not be *verified*.
* The Pass-2 verify step is what converts a candidate finding into a decided one. When it fails,
  **every** finding degrades to `no-verification`, and the whole review degrades to INDETERMINATE
  and refuses to sign. So a single provider-side 400 on one step **fails the entire gate closed**,
  with no partial credit for the ~20 criteria that did evaluate cleanly.
* It is **not transient**: two independent runs, minutes apart, different plan text, identical
  failure. Retrying is not a remedy — the second attempt cost a full cold review (run 1: 27 LLM
  calls, 334s, 1.33M input tokens) and bought nothing.
* A ticket in this state **cannot be claimed**, because the claim gate wants a certified
  plan-review attestation. So a provider-side grammar-compilation timeout is currently sufficient to
  block all work on a ticket indefinitely.

## What "Grammar compilation timed out" means

It is a Bedrock-side failure to compile the constrained-decoding grammar for a structured-output
request — i.e. the response schema handed to `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6` is too large or too
complex for the service to compile within its own time limit. It is a function of the SCHEMA, not of
the plan's content, which is consistent with it reproducing across two quite different plan bodies.
Related signal in the same logs: `LLMUnavailableError` x8 and, in run 1, a separate
`UnexpectedModelBehavior: Exceeded maximum output retries (2)` from the overlap judge.

## Suggested directions (not prescriptive)

* Make the verify step's structured contract smaller/simpler, or split it, so the grammar compiles.
* Fall back to the PROMPTED structured path (the deterministic tolerant parse the reliability stack
  already has) when a provider rejects NATIVE constrained decoding with a compilation error, rather
  than surfacing it as an opaque provider outage.
* Degrade the step rather than the whole review: an unverified finding could stay advisory and let
  the review sign, instead of forcing INDETERMINATE across the board.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] a "Grammar compilation timed out" / `ValidationException` from the provider on a structured
      call is not surfaced as a generic provider outage; it is classified distinctly so the cause is
      visible in the operator message
- [ ] the plan-review Pass-2 verify step completes against the model configured in this environment
      for a plan of at least the size that reproduces the failure (c827's description, ~19,800 chars)
- [ ] a single failed verify step no longer degrades every finding to `no-verification`: either the
      step is retried on a path that can succeed, or the review reports which findings were verified
      and which were not, and its signing decision reflects that distinction rather than failing all
      closed
- [ ] a regression test drives the failure classification path with a simulated provider
      grammar-compilation rejection and asserts it is not reported as an outage

## Evidence

`/tmp/c827-planreview.log` (run 1) and `/tmp/c827-planreview2.log` (run 2), both containing the
verbatim 400 body. Discovered while attempting to earn the claim attestation for
[rebar:c827-2a23-cd00-473e].
data.title: Plan-review Pass-2 verify fails on Bedrock 'Grammar compilation timed out', degrading every finding to INDETERMINATE
